shelves.definition: Flat horizontal surfaces used for storage or display, typically attached to a wall or forming part of a piece of furniture.
shelves.generation_notes: Decomposing 'shelves' into functional nouns (bookshelf, rack) helps capture variations, but the anchor 'shelves' is essential to avoid missing bare wall-mounted planks.

wood.definition: Solid material derived from trees, usually referring to structural or background wooden elements not categorized under specific furniture.

bedclothes.definition: Fabric coverings used on a bed for warmth and hygiene.
bedclothes.generation_notes: Empirically validated: The term 'bedclothes' is somewhat archaic; expanding positive prompts to 'blanket', 'quilt', and 'duvet' significantly improves segmentation performance on bedding items.

sidewalk.definition: Part of ground designated for pedestrians or cyclists. Delimited from the road by some obstacle, e.g. curbs or poles (might be small), not only by markings. Often elevated compared to the road.
sidewalk.generation_notes: Keep 'sidewalk' as the anchor and add at most one additional prompt. Never add 'curb' as a standalone prompt.

computer.definition: Electronic device for processing data, typically referring to desktops, mainframes, or visible PC cases.

bed.definition: A piece of furniture for sleep or rest, including the frame and mattress.

ground.definition: The solid surface of the earth outdoors, usually natural terrain as opposed to paved roads.

building.definition: A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school, store, or factory.

cloth.definition: Generic fabric or textile material not specifically forming clothing, bedclothes, or curtains.

truck.definition: A large, heavy motor vehicle used for transporting goods, materials, or troops.

flower.definition: The seed-bearing part of a plant, consisting of reproductive organs, typically surrounded by brightly colored petals.

mouse.definition: A hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen.

platform.definition: A raised level surface on which people or things can stand, typically at a railway station.

door.definition: A hinged, sliding, or revolving barrier at the entrance to a building, room, or vehicle.

window.definition: An opening in the wall or roof of a building or vehicle that is fitted with glass to admit light or air.

bench.definition: A long seat for several people, typically made of wood or stone.

bag.definition: A flexible container with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

fence.definition: A barrier, railing, or other upright structure enclosing an area of ground.

cabinet.definition: A piece of furniture with shelves or drawers for storing or displaying items.

road.definition: A wide way leading from one place to another, typically paved, for vehicles.

floor.definition: The lower surface of a room, on which one may walk.

light.definition: A source of illumination, including light fixtures and lamps.

track.definition: A continuous line of rails on a railway.

sign.definition: An object whose primary purpose is to display information or instructions.

ceiling.definition: The upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

wall.definition: A continuous vertical brick or stone structure that encloses or divides an area of land or a room.

rock.definition: A solid mass of geological materials. Includes boulders and large stones.

pottedplant.definition: A plant grown in a container rather than in the ground.

chair.definition: A separate seat for one person, typically with a back and four legs.

mountain.definition: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding level.

curtain.definition: A piece of material suspended at the top to form a covering or screen, typically at a window.

book.definition: A written or printed work consisting of pages glued or sewn together along one side and bound in covers.

table.definition: A piece of furniture with a flat top and one or more legs, providing a level surface on which objects may be placed.

sofa.definition: A long upholstered seat with a back and arms, for two or more people.
